package workbench

// 与业务系统交换的事实类型；输入字段由调用方设置，动作写回输出字段。
declare RuleInput
    customerAge : Integer
    annualIncome : Double
    creditScore : Integer
    customerType : String
    overdue : Boolean
    riskLevel : String
    reviewRequired : Boolean
    approvedLimit : Double
end

rule "信用评级决策表（演示） 第1行 [1]"
    salience 3
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( creditScore >= 700, customerType in ("企业", "同业") )
then
    modify($input) {
        setRiskLevel("低"),
        setReviewRequired(false)
    }
end

rule "信用评级决策表（演示） 第2行 [2]"
    salience 2
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( creditScore >= 501, creditScore <= 699, customerType == "个人" )
then
    modify($input) {
        setRiskLevel("中"),
        setReviewRequired(true)
    }
end

rule "信用评级决策表（演示） 第3行 [3]"
    salience 1
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( creditScore <= 500 )
then
    modify($input) {
        setRiskLevel("高"),
        setReviewRequired(true)
    }
end

rule "信用评级决策表（演示） 默认行 [4]"
    salience -1
    no-loop true
when
    not RuleInput( creditScore >= 700, customerType in ("企业", "同业") )
    not RuleInput( creditScore >= 501, creditScore <= 699, customerType == "个人" )
    not RuleInput( creditScore <= 500 )
    $input : RuleInput(  )
then
    modify($input) {
        setRiskLevel("中"),
        setReviewRequired(false)
    }
end

package workbench

// 与业务系统交换的事实类型；输入字段由调用方设置，动作写回输出字段。
declare RuleInput
    warehouseId : String
    phase : String
    pctAtLeastMax : Boolean
    pctBelowMin : Boolean
    circElapsed : Boolean
    endReached : Boolean
    paused : Boolean
    nitrogenPct : Double
    maxPct : Double
    minPct : Double
    nextPhase : String
    genCmd : String
    fillValveCmd : String
    circValveCmd : String
    fanCmd : String
    reason : String
end

rule "充氮设备态表 第1行 [1]"
    salience 40000006
    activation-group "decision-table:ee93be19-43ea-4570-a116-5413c360c419"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "FILLING" )
then
    modify($input) {
        setGenCmd("ON"),
        setFillValveCmd("OPEN"),
        setCircValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("ON"),
        setReason("充氮中，设备密闭充氮")
    }
end

rule "充氮设备态表 第2行 [2]"
    salience 40000005
    activation-group "decision-table:ee93be19-43ea-4570-a116-5413c360c419"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "REPLENISHING" )
then
    modify($input) {
        setGenCmd("ON"),
        setFillValveCmd("OPEN"),
        setCircValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("OFF"),
        setReason("补氮中，设备密闭充氮")
    }
end

rule "充氮设备态表 第3行 [3]"
    salience 40000004
    activation-group "decision-table:ee93be19-43ea-4570-a116-5413c360c419"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "CIRCULATION" )
then
    modify($input) {
        setGenCmd("OFF"),
        setFillValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setCircValveCmd("OPEN"),
        setFanCmd("ON"),
        setReason("环流中，通风循环")
    }
end

rule "充氮设备态表 第4行 [4]"
    salience 40000003
    activation-group "decision-table:ee93be19-43ea-4570-a116-5413c360c419"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "HOLDING" )
then
    modify($input) {
        setGenCmd("OFF"),
        setFillValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setCircValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("OFF"),
        setReason("保氮中，设备全关")
    }
end

rule "充氮设备态表 第5行 [5]"
    salience 40000002
    activation-group "decision-table:ee93be19-43ea-4570-a116-5413c360c419"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "PAUSED" )
then
    modify($input) {
        setGenCmd("OFF"),
        setFillValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setCircValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("OFF"),
        setReason("暂停中，设备全关")
    }
end

rule "充氮设备态表 第6行 [6]"
    salience 40000001
    activation-group "decision-table:ee93be19-43ea-4570-a116-5413c360c419"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "PENDING" )
then
    modify($input) {
        setGenCmd("OFF"),
        setFillValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setCircValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("OFF"),
        setReason("未启动，设备全关")
    }
end

package workbench

// 与业务系统交换的事实类型；输入字段由调用方设置，动作写回输出字段。
declare RuleInput
    warehouseId : String
    phase : String
    pctAtLeastMax : Boolean
    pctBelowMin : Boolean
    circElapsed : Boolean
    endReached : Boolean
    paused : Boolean
    nitrogenPct : Double
    maxPct : Double
    minPct : Double
    nextPhase : String
    genCmd : String
    fillValveCmd : String
    circValveCmd : String
    fanCmd : String
    reason : String
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第1行 [1]"
    salience 30000007
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "PENDING", endReached == false, paused == false )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("FILLING"),
        setReason("开始充氮，进入充氮期")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第2行 [2]"
    salience 30000006
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "FILLING", endReached == false, paused == false, pctAtLeastMax == true )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("CIRCULATION"),
        setReason("浓度达最大，停止充氮转环流")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第3行 [3]"
    salience 30000005
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "CIRCULATION", endReached == false, paused == false, circElapsed == true )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("HOLDING"),
        setReason("环流期满，进入保氮期")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第4行 [4]"
    salience 30000004
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "HOLDING", endReached == false, paused == false, pctBelowMin == true )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("REPLENISHING"),
        setReason("浓度低于最小，开充氮补氮")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第5行 [5]"
    salience 30000003
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "REPLENISHING", endReached == false, paused == false, pctAtLeastMax == true )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("CIRCULATION"),
        setReason("补氮达标，停止充氮转环流")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第6行 [6]"
    salience 30000002
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( endReached == true )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("COMPLETED"),
        setReason("到达结束时间，充氮结束")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第7行 [7]"
    salience 30000001
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( paused == true )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("PAUSED"),
        setReason("暂停中，设备全关")
    }
end

    }
end
